[Race Girl]
Would you like to visit ^0000FFMorocc Raceway^000000?
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
您想去^0000FF摩洛克赛道^000000吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Alright, talk to me again when you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
好的，想去的时候再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Welcome to Morocc Raceway!
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
欢迎来到摩洛克赛道！

scripts.text: Information
scripts.translation: 资讯

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Someone must click on the Starter NPC to start the race.
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
必须点击发令员NPC才能开始比赛。

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Once the race is started, run around Morocc anti-clockwise.
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
比赛开始后，请逆时针绕摩洛克跑。

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
You must reach all the checkpoints - No cheating!
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
必须到达所有检查点——不许作弊！

scripts.text:
[Race Girl]
Come again soon!
scripts.translation:
[赛车女郎]
欢迎再次光临！

scripts.text:
[Race Starter]
Please stay on the Eastern side of me.
scripts.translation:
[赛跑发令员]
请待在我的东侧。
